{{recipe}}
== Ingredients ==

* 2 racks of [[Cookbook:Lamb|lamb]], trimmed and frenched
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely chopped
* Kosher [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]
* 1 ½ tbsp smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Garlic Powder|garlic powder]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both racks of lamb with olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika, garlic powder, and kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Rub seasonings into the meat.
#Place both racks in a [[Cookbook:Bundt Cake Pan|bundt pan]] and tie the end bones together with butcher's [[Cookbook:Twine|twine]].
#Place on the middle rack of the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] and [[Cookbook:Roasting|roast]] for 30–35 minutes, until the meat reaches an internal temperature of 145°F for medium rare.
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. Serve.
